title: Rewards can possibly be left stuck in contract
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** High, as it is a value loss for the protocol/its users  **Likelihood:** Low, as it needs a special scenario to be present  ## Description  Currently in `TopliaLpStaking::setRewards` we have this comment:  > // This must be called AFTER some LP are staked (or ensure at least 1 LP position is staked before the start timestamp)  While the issue is pointed out here, it is not enforced in a smart contract native manner and the code is still vulnerable.
